{{recipe}}

'''Cocktail sauce''', sometimes also called '''seafood sauce''', is typically a tomato-based sauce served with seafood.

==Ingredients==
*½ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] [[Cookbook:Ketchup|ketchup]]
*½ cup Heinz [[Cookbook:Chile Paste and Sauce|Chili Sauce]] (optional, and can be substituted with ketchup)
*1 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] [[Cookbook:Lemon|lemon]] juice
*1 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] [[Cookbook:Worcestershire Sauce|Worcestershire sauce]]
*~¼ tsp [[Cookbook:Tabasco Sauce|Tabasco sauce]]
*1 [[Cookbook:Pinch|pinch]] coarsely ground black [[Cookbook:Pepper|pepper]]
*2–3 tbsp prepared grated [[Cookbook:Horseradish|horseradish]]
==Procedure==
#Combine all ingredients except horseradish. 
#Taste and adjust flavors to your liking. Some recipes call for the addition of [[Cookbook:Celery salt|celery salt]] or garlic juice.
#Add a tablespoon at a time to get it to the taste you prefer. If your grated horseradish is fresh (a fresh bottle from the store), the recipe amount may be too much for your liking; if it is older, the recipe amount may not be enough.
#Refrigerate until cold.
#Place cold sauce into serving dish. Serve with seafood.
